messages.en: Could you turn off the kitchen light? I'm going to bed now.
Just a sec. Let me wash this cup first, then I'll turn it off.

senses.en_definition: An informal variant of mahu: to want or intend to do something.
An informal variant of mahu: to be willing or prepared to do something.

messages.en: I want to head home now. I'm so tired. Want to come along?
You go ahead. I'm waiting for Hafiz. He's not here yet.
Okay, let him know I've headed home, will you? We'll chat more tomorrow.
I've read the news about that accident. Don't drive too fast, okay? It could get you killed.
Yeah, I get it. I'll take it slow tonight.

senses.en_definition: An English abbreviation of maximum, used in mixed-language contexts to indicate the highest amount, number, or limit.

messages.en: Let's keep it to 10 people max for that dinner. The table can't fit any more.
We've got eight people so far, right? If I invite two more, that'll make exactly 10.
